name: Town Gates
desc1: You are before the massive town gates of Silvermere. They stand over
desc2: fifteen feet high, and are made of three foot thick, steel-banded
desc3: hardwood. Guard towers flank the gates on either side, and you can see
desc4: the town militia patrolling overtop on the walls. Estwall street runs
desc5: to the north and south, following the city wall. To the west, Silver
desc6: street runs to the heart of the city, ending at the town square.
